solves.reason: (A) gradual process, (B) downright dangerous, (C) reasonable limits - all match original
(A) complete latitude (freedom), (B) overwhelmed by choices, (C) limited options
(A) maturity (based on age, maturity), (B) prevent (tend to prevent people), (C) inundated (won't be inundated)
② harmless is wrong; original is dangerous. Giving complete latitude is downright dangerous, not harmless
① enriched is wrong; original is inundated. Won't be inundated(flooded), not enriched(made richer)
③ promote is wrong; original is prevent. Choices tend to prevent people from making decisions, not promote
overwhelmed by the choices - children would be overwhelmed (unable to cope) with too many options
complete latitude - it would be dangerous to give children complete latitude(freedom) in decision making
inundated - won't be inundated(flooded/overwhelmed) by huge number of options
gradual = progressive = step-by-step. Not instant, dramatic, or complete
overwhelmed = swamped = flooded with too much. Not relieved, encouraged, or satisfied
prevent = hinder = block = stop from doing. Not permit, promote, or assist
dangerous opposite is harmless. risky/hazardous/threatening are synonyms of dangerous
limited opposite is boundless(unlimited/infinite). restricted/finite/scarce are similar to limited
(A) treat=간식(snack/reward) in food context, (B) treat=치료하다(cure/heal) in medical context
'freedom to act or make decisions without being controlled' = latitude
by + V-ing: preposition by requires gerund. set → setting
won't be + p.p. (passive): inundate → inundated. Children won't be inundated by options
'reasonable limits' - setting reasonable limits to their decisions. Not complete latitude/poor decisions/limited options
'the huge number of options available' - won't be inundated by the huge number of options available to them
